claims.claim: China is expected to invest $940 billion in energy in 2026, the most by any country, according to the Global Energy Transition Report 2026.
claims.episode_span: China is set to lead global energy investment in 2026 with $940 billion according to the Global Energy Transition Report.
claims.source_title: China Set to Lead World in Energy Investment in 2026, CCTV Says
claims.supporting_quote: China is expected to invest $940 billion in energy in 2026, the most by any country, according to the Global Energy Transition Report 2026 released by the China Enterprise Reform and Development Society, China Central Television reported Sunday.
